connector.name: Curie Commerce
connector.registryDescription: Search, compare in 3D, and buy products from 5.6M+ Shopify stores. Free tier; Pro adds checkout.
connector.summary: Hosted at chat.curie.app over server sent events. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace co.curie. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional 'Bearer <token>' from Curie Pro OAuth (https://chat.curie.app/api/oauth/authorize). Without it, the free tier (100 req/min/IP) is used.
